title: Subscribe to the hostile-negotiation projection before interpreting its empty cache
classification: Source-backed native observation wiring defect; frozen PR and merged snapshots, not executed or attributed to a specific introducing commit
contract_trace: The simulator attempts a peaceful hostile withdrawal from backend_hostile_negotiations when a present generated case site allows combat. Both actual explicit subscription lists in run_core_loop_inner omit this view, and the frozen simulator source contains no other subscription registration. The generated accessor obtains a local table handle and iterates its cache; it does not query or subscribe. SDK2.6.1 creates an empty cache table during registration and retains only subscribed rows. Thus absence of an installed observation is interpreted as an observed absence of a negotiation opportunity, and the intended negotiation branch is skipped.
counterexample: A registered strategic gateway with an occupied case site, active sapient negotiable hostile group, valid current drive-off capability, exact living spokesman and shared language causes the actual authoritative view1221:336–405 to emit a row for that party leader and site. The simulator is subscribed to its other public case/site state but never requests this view. Local backend_hostile_negotiations iteration therefore remains empty, so generated_cases bypasses negotiate_hostile_withdrawal and proceeds to combat assessment/retreat. This is a conditional ordinary supported view state derived from source, not an executed run or a claim that every case offers negotiation.
repair: Repair the complete simulator observation installation and receiving contract together: include the existing gateway-only backend_hostile_negotiations query in the enumerated post-registration subscription, await that subscription before using the cache, and preserve the public owner/site binding when selecting a negotiation. Keep absent or unavailable observation distinct from a successfully installed empty projection in any retained readiness contract used by this family. Reuse the generated query/accessor and existing canonical public negotiation types; do not edit generated bindings, subscribe to private hostile/group/case tables, fabricate a negotiation, or infer hidden eligibility. Preserve negotiation-first policy, actual reducer authorization, first failure/replan behavior and existing combat/retreat outcomes.
